prompts.name: kjp_cover_ai1
prompts.prompt: Recreate image 1 as a clean, high-quality, professional editorial photo composite. Use image 1 for the exact layout: a man in a black v-neck t-shirt and thin metal glasses sits in front of a plain beige wall, large in the center-right of the frame from head to chest; at the upper-left behind him floats a rounded rectangle card with a thin white border showing the grid of video thumbnails from image 3, partly hidden behind his head and shoulder, with a soft drop shadow. The man must be EXACTLY the person in image 2: same face shape, eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, beard, hair, glasses and expression. Do not beautify or change his features or age. Make it look like one natural photograph: realistic soft studio light on his face, natural edges and hair, sharp high resolution, no cut-out halo. Keep the thumbnail card content as in image 3. Do not add any new text, logos or watermark. The bottom 35% of the frame should become darker and simple (his black t-shirt and shadow) to leave room for a title.

prompts.name: kjp_cover_ai2
prompts.prompt: Create a high-quality editorial thumbnail photo. Take the man from image 1 (keep his identity exactly: same face, glasses, beard, hair, black v-neck t-shirt, same expression; do not beautify) and place him large in the center-right, head to chest, in front of a plain warm beige wall like in image 1. At the upper-left, behind him, put a floating rounded card with a thin white border showing the video thumbnail grid from image 2, partially covered by his head and shoulder, with a soft shadow. Realistic lighting, crisp sharp detail, natural edges, looks like a single real photo. No new text, logos or watermark. Make the bottom 35% darker and simple for a title.
